description: Electricity Regulation Database is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Infrastructure industries-including telecommunications, electricity, water, and gas-underwent massive structural changes in the 1990s. During that decade, hundreds of privatization transactions valued at billions of dollars were completed in these sectors in developing and transition economies. Coverage: 20 countries. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Energy access, Policies and plans. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
